<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsVisible object="crayon" />
                <Say text="I can see the crayon" />
            </Sequence>
            <Say text="I don't see the crayon" />
        </Fallback>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

request: my mouse wandered off lol, fetch it back to me?
description: find the computer mouse, grab it and bring it to the user
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="computer mouse" />
                <SearchFor object="computer mouse" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="computer mouse" />
            <Grab object="computer mouse" />
            <NavigateTo target="user" />
            <Release target="user" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
